title: Hello In Ten Languages
style: global pop celebration, 116 BPM, joyful multicultural energy, different greetings per verse, world percussion, PLUGGED education theme, call and response, male vocal warm and inviting, original sound, V4_5ALL
lyrics:
[INTRO — world percussion]

[VERSE 1 — English]
Hello — that's where it starts
One word — one open heart
In any language — first word counts
Learn it — that's what mounts

[CHORUS — call and response]
Kia ora! (Kia ora!)
Hola! (Hola!)
Konnichiwa! (Konnichiwa!)
Sawubona! (Sawubona!)
Bonjour! (Bonjour!)
Marhaba! (Marhaba!)
Namaste! (Namaste!)
G'day! (G'day!)

[VERSE 2]
The first word is the whole game
Say it in their tongue — not the same
PLUGGED teaches you the greeting
Before the first meeting
MOSOKO voice in your language
KERVALON — your name's heritage
One word — respect established
Get cultured — it's accomplished

[OUTRO — fading through languages]
Hello. Hola. Kia ora. Konnichiwa. Sawubona. G'day.
